tagline: Chinon取景器相机，1978 年发布
description: Chinon于1978年推出的取景器相机。配备CHINONEX COLOR 38mm/F2.8。快门速度1 / 60 to 1 / 250 seconds with mechanical self-timer。使用26x24mm frames on 35mm film。

specs.电池: 2 AA for flash, HC-(MR44) mercury cell for meter.
specs.英文简介: The 35F-EE is the scale-focusing version of Chinon's model 35F-A (which has autofocus).
